description: Election Commission - Declare that M. M. Sitthy Jaleela was Selected as the member of the Akkaraipattu Municipal  Council - Declare that A. C. M. Nawfer was Selected as member of the Akkaraipattu Municipal Council
categorisation: This gazette content deals specifically with filling vacancies in a municipal council under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves electoral processes at the local government level, including the declaration of selected members to fill positions vacated by resignation, which falls under election-related matters.
